craft_notes: Sthāyin: two sixfold ladders. Rows: above then below. Read aloud: double roll.

lines: As in heart, throat, palate, brow, cleft, twelve's-end the six — Brahmā, Pervader, Roarer, Lord, the Blest, the Unheld —
so in in-breath too, in heart-bud bliss-wane-wax twelve's-ends:
child, youth, age, rebirth, release — these wardens.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yathā ca hṛtkaṇṭhatālulalāṭarandhradvādaśānteṣu brahmaviṣṇurudreśasadāśivānāśritākhyaṃ kāraṇaṣaṭkam tathaiva apāne 'pi hṛtkandānandasaṃkocavikāsadvādaśānteṣu bālyayauvanavārddhakanidhanapunarbhavamuktyadhipataya ete
